title: Add retry with exponential backoff for Groq & Cerebras in router
description: Currently when Groq returns HTTP 429 rate limit errors, the client immediately fails instead of applying the configured router backoff retry strategy. Catch 429s specifically in litellm/router.py and schedule retry.

title: Support custom Ollama host URL in multi-agent tool execution worker
description: When agents run with local Ollama models on a remote LAN server, the OllamaWorker defaults to localhost. Allow passing custom base_url in crewai/agents/cache.py.

title: Add CLI flag to display model architecture metadata and license warning
description: Users need a quick way to inspect model licensing (Apache 2.0 vs MIT vs Custom) directly from the terminal with `ollama show --license <model>`. Add flag parser in cmd/interactive.go.

title: Fix dark-mode contrast on model parameters drawer in settings tab
description: In dark mode, the slider labels for temperature and top_p in the Model Parameters modal have insufficient contrast ratio. Update Tailwind color class in src/lib/components/Settings.svelte.

title: Add validation for HuggingFace Dataset streaming buffer size parameter
description: HuggingFaceDatasetLoader throws an unhelpful KeyError when buffer_size is passed as a string or negative integer. Add Pydantic field validator in langchain_community/document_loaders/hugging_face_dataset.py.

title: Add audio chunking progress bar for long Whisper transcription jobs
description: When transcribing audio files longer than 30 minutes, the CLI provides no progress indicator. Integrate tqdm callback in transcribe() loop inside whisper/transcribe.py.

title: Sanitize node names to prevent invalid characters in exported workflow JSON
description: Custom node labels containing slashes or quotes cause corrupted JSON when exporting prompt workflows. Add regex replacement in execution.py before serializing prompt graph.

title: Add fallback healthcheck timeout when Docker container spins up on ARM64
description: On Apple Silicon or ARM64 instances, Celery worker takes 15s longer to initialize, triggering premature docker-compose healthcheck failure. Bump initial interval in docker/docker-compose.yaml.

title: Improve error message when Milvus vector store index is uninitialized
description: MilvusVectorStore raises generic PyMilvusException when the target collection exists but index has not finished building. Wrap error in human-readable exception with resolution tip.

title: Add unit test verifying termination condition in multi-agent group chat
description: Add regression test verifying that GroupChatManager respects max_round limit and custom is_termination_msg callback when speakers don't yield.
